description: France's capital, dense and highly walkable with an extensive metro and a growing low-emission zone.
sustainability_summary: Strong rail links from across Europe, expanding cycle network and car-restricted central districts make low-carbon visits realistic.

description: Germany's capital, spacious and bike-friendly with a comprehensive U-Bahn/S-Bahn network.
sustainability_summary: Excellent public transport, abundant green space and a mature second-hand/repair culture support low-impact stays.

description: A compact canal city where cycling is the dominant mode of transport.
sustainability_summary: World-leading cycling infrastructure and frequent international rail make car-free, low-carbon travel the default.

description: Denmark's capital, consistently ranked among the world's most sustainable cities.
sustainability_summary: Carbon-neutral city ambitions, district heating, harbour swimming and a cycling-first design make it a benchmark eco-destination.
